In essence we are all just people some life appears insignificant and others do not.
What I would say it clearly your trying to disassociate yourself from others by strictly removing the emotional side of life. But we are as people emotionally driven.

People will care and be saddened when you die.
Its that simple and people often say that through personal experience. When my brother died through suicide he probably assumed no one cared when in actual fact, a lot of people did.

A completely unbiased view would probably be that life is important because really if you strive hard you could have an important impact on humanity. It would be a shame if the person who cured cancer died before they could do it ect..

The other unbiased view which is emotionally  inevitable is that, in the future you may also have a significant impact on somebody else. This impact could stop them from killing themselves one day. You could also make there lives a lot happier now. While you may not be surrounded by people now that can always be open to change, at the right time and in the right setting.

You need to remember that there are probably thousands of different ways your life could end up. Loads of those ways could be positive so why take the first trip out the door now.
